name: Kinaxis
tagline: Kinaxis is an enterprise supply chain management platform that uses AI and concurrent planning to give companies end-to-end visibility and rapid response capability across demand, supply, and operations. Its RapidResponse platform helps manufacturers and retailers reduce risk and improve agility.
